row_id.definition: Immutable row locator in the consumed-value snapshot.

feature_value.definition: Finite numeric value consumed by the model matrix.

prediction_time.definition: Signal fixation at 16:00 Asia/Shanghai after T close.

event_time.definition: T session close represented by the derived feature.

parse_ready_time.definition: Time the immutable source snapshot was parse-ready.

ingestion_batch_id.definition: Historical system batch; nullable for market claim.

ingested_object_sha256.definition: Historical object hash; nullable for market claim.

tradable_time.definition: T+1 eligible session open intended for execution.

label_start_time.definition: Raw-price label interval start at T+1 open.

label_end_time.definition: Raw-price label interval end at T+5 close.

universe_member.definition: Eligibility under the frozen CSI800 PIT rule.

revision_known_time.definition: Time the selected derived revision became available.

adjustment_known_time.definition: Applied adjustment availability; null for RAW.

adjustment_invariance_pass.definition: Adjustment invariance result; null for RAW.

halt_time.definition: Execution-overlapping halt start; null when absent.

quote_resume_time.definition: Quote resume time; null when absent.

trade_resume_time.definition: Trade resume time; null when absent.
